items.title: Pull tabs
steps: Pull the left tab for Notification Center, the right for Control Center.

items.title: Panels follow your finger
steps: Swipe up slowly and let go early. It should spring back.

items.title: Steady StandBy clocks
steps: Try each clock. The colons should hold still.

items.title: Compatibility before Get
steps: Open a package. Get should say if it works on your phone.

items.title: Phone settings in Spotlight
steps: Type "display". Open the match.

items.title: Island tint and ticker
steps: Get a notification. The pill should match the app's color.

items.title: Island flashlight
steps: Turn the flashlight on. An amber light should show. Tap it to turn off.

items.title: Widget drop preview
steps: Move a widget around. An outline should show where it fits.

items.title: App menu color
steps: Hold an app. The menu should take the icon's color.

items.title: Unfolded page spacing
steps: Unfold flat: pages sit closer. Part way: they ease apart.

items.title: Nixie and Minimal clocks
steps: Pick each one and look at how it reads.

items.title: StandBy widget stack
steps: Tap or swipe the card to switch widgets.

items.title: Page edge resistance
steps: Swipe past the first page. It should pull back softly.

items.title: Expand a widget
steps: Hold a widget, then choose Expand temporarily.

items.title: Status rail and charging bolt
steps: Plug in. A small bolt should show by the battery.

items.title: Control Center toggles
steps: Flip a few toggles. Tap Wi-Fi for its panel.

items.title: Ambient lamp
steps: Turn on Dual-Screen Ambient Light. The cover screen should glow.

items.title: Notification preview pane
steps: Tap a notification. Its preview should open on the right.

items.title: StandBy clock looks
steps: Try all twelve. The preview should fit in day and night.

items.title: StandBy widgets
steps: Tap the card to switch between Calendar and Vitals.

items.title: StandBy notifications
steps: Send a notification. The edge should glow softly.

items.title: Ambient glow
items.where: Fold in tent or half open
steps: Turn StandBy on. The outer screen should glow.

items.title: Swipe to Discover
steps: Swipe left. No background should flash.

items.title: Control Center pages
steps: Swipe down between tiles for the next page. Swipe up to go back.

items.title: Side Bar tap and hold
steps: Tap it for Control Center. Hold it: no second pill.

items.title: Sliders follow volume keys
steps: Play music, open Control Center, press the volume keys.

items.title: Folders blur Home
steps: Open a folder. Home should blur behind it.

items.title: Landscape Home
steps: Rotate the phone. Every row should stay whole.

items.title: A turned-off app keeps its spot
steps: Turn an app off. Its icon should stay, dimmed.

items.title: Large text
steps: Set the largest font. Nothing should be cut off.

items.title: Settings stays put
steps: Change Display size, then come back. You should be on the same page.

items.title: Pull down from any app
steps: Drag down from the top of another app. A panel should open.

items.title: Control Center look and size
steps: Try each look and size. Text should stay readable.

items.title: Smart clock ink
steps: Turn it on. The clock should be light or dark to suit.

items.title: Setup: Your Home apps
steps: Tick some apps. The grid should change at once. Then tap Skip.

items.title: Rows shows Automatic
steps: Pick 6 rows, reopen the menu. Automatic should show its number.

items.title: Settings in three groups
steps: Look around. Tell us if anything is hard to find.

items.title: Widgets make room
steps: Drop a widget on apps. They should move aside.
